newsitem.title: FRANCE: Rhone shares leap 15 pct after RPR news.
newsitem.headline: Rhone shares leap 15 pct after RPR news.

text.p: Shares in Rhone-Poulenc requoted 15.15 percent higher on the Paris bourse on Thursday, after news it was considering buying out its U.S. unit Rhone-Poulenc Rorer .
The stock was suspended temporarily at the stock market open under rules controlling major share price movements but requoted at 0845 GMT at 244 francs.
The share fluctuated after requoting and stood at 244.2 francs, up 15.24 percent at 0852 GMT.
"There are huge orders coming in from everywhere. It's gone mad," said one trader.
The company earlier said it was considering buying the rest of its U.S. RPR unit and called a news conference for 0900 GMT.
